Word count: 77
Analog Monte Carlo simulation of photon transport in a 30x30x30 cm^3 water phantom. Source: 2 MeV point source at SSD=100 cm, uniform in solid angle within pyramid defining a 10x10 cm^2 field. Scoring: cylinder (r=1 cm, thickness 0.2 cm) on axis at 10 cm depth. Cross sections: Compton (Klein-Nishina), photoelectric (power-law fit to NIST), pair production (Bethe-Heitler approximation), Rayleigh (forward-peaked form factor). Compton angle sampled by rejection from Klein-Nishina. 200 unbiased interactions recorded from ~530k primary histories.
